segments.comment: An amulet of unchanging keeps a polymorphed hero who genocides her own race in kobold form with u.uhp == -1 (read.c do_genocide()). ^R clears the screen (wintty.c tty_clear_nhwindow() NHW_MAP sets disp.botlx and blanks the status window's cw->data), and botl.c bot() returns without drawing but clears that disp.botlx. The self-zap kills the kobold; rehumanize() calls done(), whose own bot() is skipped too. At the Die? prompt flush_screen()'s bot() therefore sends only the fields that changed (evaluate_and_notify_windowport()): BL_HP alone, which wintty.c check_fields() draws over the blank row.
